resources.string: Sign in with your Google account to keep your shelves and reading log on all your devices.
Shelf works fully without an account. Your books stay on this device either way; signing in copies them to your account.
Sync isn\'t set up in this build. Everything else works offline. To enable sync, build the app with a Firebase configuration (see the README).
There\'s no Google account on this device. Add one in system settings, then try again.
